description: Tribunal: verdict. WHEN: close deliberation and compute the verdict. Party or seated juror only. Verdict = majority of non-abstain votes, only with quorum (majority of the seated panel cast). If quorum is not met, or the decisive vote is tied (hung jury), NO verdict is returned and the case stays in deliberation — more votes can still land. On a verdict the case moves deliberation -> verdict and the implied enforcement action is previewed (data only). Example: tribunal_verdict {"case_id":"<case_id>"}
